	agb4ddcae9e010eb5e18b2fd771bf6c600 A0
GROUP BY
	A0.dim5b35e57

WITH ag46352eedb979cb599fdba6aa73e16943 AS (
SELECT
	DATE_TRUNC('month', T1."d_date")::DATE AS "dim5b35e57",
	sum(T0."ss_net_paid") AS "msr8a51bb0"
FROM
	store_sales T0
	JOIN date_dim T1
		ON T0.ss_sold_date_sk = T1.d_date_sk
GROUP BY
	DATE_TRUNC('month', T1."d_date")::DATE
)
SELECT
	A0.dim5b35e57 AS "Month(Date)",
	max(A0.msr8a51bb0) AS "Net Paid",
	sum(sum(A0.msr8a51bb0) * 2) OVER ( ORDER BY A0.dim5b35e57) AS "2x Net Paid"
FROM
	ag46352eedb979cb599fdba6aa73e16943 A0
GROUP BY
	A0.dim5b35e57
